Draft affirmative.label: Draft, needs approval
Draft affirmative.say: It cannot become law until Parliament approves it.

Made affirmative.label: Already law, needs approval
Made affirmative.say: It is already law, but it stops being law unless Parliament approves it within a set time.

Draft negative.label: Draft, goes ahead unless a House objects
Draft negative.say: It becomes law unless either House objects within 40 days.

Made negative.label: Already law, unless a House objects
Made negative.say: It is already law, and stays law unless either House objects within 40 days.

recent.name: Water Supply and Sewerage Services (Customer Service Standards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Water Supply and Sewerage Services (Customer Service Standards) Regulations 2008.
recent.department: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

recent.name: State Pension Revaluation for Transitional Pensions Order 2026
summary: This Order is made following a review under section 148AC(1) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (revaluation for transitional pensions under the Pensions Act 2014 ).
The Pensions Act 2014 created a new state pension for persons reaching pensionable age on or after 6th April 2016 (see Part 1 of that Act).
Pensionable age has the meaning given by the rules in paragraph 1 of Schedule 4 to the Pensions Act 1995.
recent.department: Department for Work and Pensions

recent.name: State Pension Debits and Credits (Revaluation) Order 2026
summary: This Order is made following a review under section 148AD(1) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (revaluation of new state pension debits and credits).
recent.department: Department for Work and Pensions

recent.name: Libya (Sanctions) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
recent.kind: Part of the post-Brexit tidy-up of the law
recent.department: Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

recent.name: Care Planning, Placement and Case Review (England) (Amendment and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Care Planning, Placement and Case Review (England) Regulations 2010, which make provision about care planning for children who are looked after by local authorities.
The amendments are made as a result of the commencement of the amendment to section 34 of the Children Act 1989 made by section 10 of the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026.
recent.department: Department for Education

recent.name: Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft (Specified Information etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify, for the purposes of paragraph 5 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021, the information that a police officer may require from a person suspected of flying an unmanned aircraft.
recent.department: Home Office

recent.name: Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement for a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) Order 2025 and The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2025 granted an exemption to Doggerbank Offshore Wind Farm Project 1 Projco Limited from the requirement to hold an electricity transmission licence in respect of Dogger Bank A Offshore Wind Farm.
recent.department: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

recent.name: Value Added Tax (Drugs and Medicines) (Health and Welfare) Order 2026
summary: This Order, which comes into force on 10th December 2026, makes amendments to Group 12 of Schedule 8 and Group 7 of Schedule 9 to the Value Added Tax Act 1994.
Group 12 zero-rates supplies of drugs, medicines and aids for the disabled.
Group 7 exempts specified supplies of health and welfare from value added tax.
recent.department: HM Treasury

recent.name: Traffic Orders and Notices (Provision of Digital Information) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision to require traffic regulation authorities in England to provide information to the Secretary of State about the traffic regulation measures that they make.

The Secretary of State will, in turn, publish that data in open data format (available via https://www.gov.uk/guidance/digital-traffic-regulation-orders-d-tro-service ) so that it can be used for the purposes set out in section 93 (5) of the Automated Vehicles Act 2024.
recent.department: Department for Transport

recent.name: Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority (Transfer of Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2026
summary: This Order provides for the conferral of the functions of the East Sussex Fire Authority and the West Sussex County Council as a fire and rescue Authority (together “the existing FRAs”) on the Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority.
A separate statutory instrument is planned to provide for the transfer of the property, rights and liabilities of the existing FRAs to the SBCCA.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) (Transfer of Property etc.) Regulations 2027
summary: These Regulations transfer the property, rights and liabilities of the East Sussex Fire Authority and the West Sussex County Council as a fire and rescue authority (together “the existing FRAs”) to the Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority, to give full effect to the conferral of fire and rescue functions on the SBCCA.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Surrey Fire and Rescue Authority (Combination Scheme) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes a scheme which combines the areas of the East Surrey and West Surrey Councils into a combined area and creates a fire and rescue authority for that area.

Under the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004, the Councils become the fire and rescue authorities for their respective areas when Surrey County Council is abolished under the Surrey (Structural Changes) Order 2026 on 1st April 2027.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Individual Savings Account (Amendment and Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Individual Savings Accounts Regulations 1998 and the Individual Savings Account (Amendment) Regulations 2025, and revoke the Individual Savings Account (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026.
recent.department: HM Treasury

recent.name: Fire and Rescue Functions (Mayoral Strategic Authorities in their Preparatory Phase) Regulations 2027
summary: These Regulations enable mayoral strategic authorities in their preparatory phase (prior to the election of the first mayor for their area) which have been designated under the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 as the fire and rescue authority for their area to exercise fire and rescue functions, including setting a precept for those functions.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Cumbria Combined Authority (Transfer of Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2026
summary: This Order provides for the conferral of the functions of the Cumbria Commissioner Fire and Rescue Authority on the Cumbria Combined Authority.
A separate statutory instrument is planned to provide for the transfer of the property, rights and liabilities of the CCFRA to the Combined Authority.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Cumbria Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) (Transfer of Property etc.) Regulations 2027
summary: These Regulations transfer the property, rights and liabilities of the Cumbria Commissioner Fire and Rescue Authority (the “CCFRA”) to the Cumbria Combined Authority (the “Combined Authority”), to give full effect to the conferral of fire and rescue functions on the Combined Authority.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Armed Forces (Amendment of Service Courts Rules) Rules 2026
summary: Under section 253A(2) of the Armed Forces Act 2006, inserted by section 6 of the Sentencing Act 2026, the court or commanding officer has a duty to make a statement in open court when passing sentence for a service offence if the court or officer is of the view that the offence involved domestic abuse carried out by the offender.
recent.department: Ministry of Defence

recent.name: Value Added Tax (Distance Selling) (Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend Schedules 9ZD, 9ZE and Part 3 of Schedule 9ZF to the Value Added Tax Act 1994 and come into force on 1st January 2027.
They implement certain amendments made by Council Directive (EU) 2025/516 to Council Directive 2006/112/EC, pursuant to the United Kingdom’s obligations under the Windsor Framework.
recent.department: HM Revenue and Customs

recent.name: Social Security (Non-Benefit Payments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify which payments are a “non-benefit payment” under section 121DA (5) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992.
recent.department: Department for Work and Pensions

recent.name: Bank Levy (Definitions and Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend definitions in Schedule 19 to the Finance Act 2011 and the Bank Levy (Loss Absorbing Instruments) Regulations 2020 in consequence of— changes to the Prudential Regulation Authority’s Rulebook, changes in consequence of the Financial Services Act 2021 and the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023, and the implementation of Basel 3.1.
recent.department: HM Treasury

recent.name: Statement of Trade Union Rights Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about the written statement which an employer is required to give to a worker under section 136A of the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992.
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

recent.name: Electricity Act 1989 (Load Control Licence) Regulations 2027
summary: These Regulations amend the Electricity Act 1989 to provide for new licensable activities relating to the carrying on of load control activities with respect to certain energy smart appliances (as defined in the Energy Act 2023 ).
These Regulations also make consequential, transitional, incidental and supplementary provisions.
recent.department: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

recent.name: Service and Administration Charges (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about service charges and administration charges in relation to leases of dwellings in England.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Scotland Act 1998 (Agency Arrangements) (Specification) (Digital Waste Tracking) Order 2026
summary: This Order paves the way for the Scottish Ministers and a Minister of the Crown to enter into agency arrangements, under which a Minister of the Crown can exercise certain functions of the designated person acting under, or in accordance with, any regulations made under section 34CA of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
Any such arrangements would be agreed between Ministers of the Crown and the Scottish Ministers.
recent.department: Privy Council Office

recent.name: Service Charges (Qualified Accountant) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify the requirement for the purposes of section 28(2)(b) of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 in relation to leases of dwellings in England.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Secretaries of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade and for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport and the Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster Order 2026
summary: This Order in Council is made under sections 1 and 2 of the Ministers of the Crown Act 1975.
recent.department: Privy Council Office

recent.name: Radio Selection Services (Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations designate a number of radio selection services for the purposes of Part 3B of the Communications Act 2023 (regulation of radio selection services).
recent.department: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport

recent.name: Litigation Costs (Exceptions to Limitation of Service and Administration Charges) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about the circumstances in which landlords of dwellings in England may recover from tenants the litigation costs that are incurred or to be incurred in leasehold disputes through service charges or administration charges.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Feed-in Tariffs (Amendment) (British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme Excluded Electricity) Order 2026
summary: This Order is made in exercise of the powers in sections 43(3)(a) and 104(2) of the Energy Act 2008.
It amends the Feed-in Tariffs Order 2012 to make amendments as to how annual levelisation payments are calculated under article 27 of that Order.

In particular, this Order introduces an exemption from that calculation for electricity supplied to customers operating in certain manufacturing sectors, under the British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme.
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

recent.name: Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
recent.kind: Part of the post-Brexit tidy-up of the law
summary: These Regulations make an amendment to the Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019, regarding temporary recognition for the purposes of Part 17 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.
recent.department: HM Treasury

recent.name: Child Safeguarding Practice Review and Relevant Agency (England) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Child Safeguarding Practice Review and Relevant Agency (England) Regulations 2018.
recent.department: Department for Education

recent.name: Building Insurance Information (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision regarding information about insurance that a landlord must give to a tenant where a service charge includes an amount payable for that insurance.
They concern leases of dwellings in England.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Building Insurance (Permitted Insurance Payments) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision regarding permitted insurance payments, which may form part of a service charge in relation to a lease of a dwelling in England.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: National Health Service (Pharmaceutical and Local Pharmaceutical Services) (Amendment) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the National Health Service (Pharmaceutical and Local Pharmaceutical Services) Regulations 2013.
The PLPS Regulations govern arrangements, in England, for the provision of pharmaceutical services and local pharmaceutical services under Part 7 of the National Heath Service Act 2006.
recent.department: Department of Health and Social Care

recent.name: Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities and Fees) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities) Order 2011 and the Marine Licensing (Application Fees) Regulations 2014.
recent.department: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

recent.name: Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) Regulations 2009 which make provision for the repayment of income-contingent student loans in England and Wales.
The amendments made by these Regulations come into force on 6th April 2027.
recent.department: Department for Education

recent.name: Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (Central Counterparties Compensation Scheme) (Independent Valuers) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations relate to the special resolution regime for central counterparties set out in Schedule 11 (central counterparties) to the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023.

The Schedule provides the Bank of England with a suite of powers to manage the failure of a central counterparty, which are exercisable by way of stabilisation instruments (as defined in the Schedule) made by the Bank of England.
recent.department: HM Treasury

recent.name: Companies and Partnerships (Strategic Report Exemptions etc.) (Amendment and Consequential Amendments) Regulations 2027
summary: These Regulations amend the Companies Act 2006.

They provide an exemption from the requirement to produce a strategic report for most medium-sized private companies and wholly-owned subsidiary companies that are included within the group strategic report of a parent undertaking.
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

recent.name: Strategic Planning Authorities (Spatial Development Strategy) Regulations 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 ) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy for their area.
These Regulations make provision as to the procedure to be followed in connection with the preparation of a SDS.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Strategic Planning (Costs of Public Examinations) (Standard Daily Amount) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations, which apply in relation to England only, apply where the Secretary of State is authorised to recover costs arising in connection with a public examination under section 12I or 12P(6)(a) of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Strategic Planning (Consequential and Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke and amend secondary legislation relating to strategic planning.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Spatial Development Strategy (Examination Procedure) Rules 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 ) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy.
Unless the Secretary of State directs otherwise, a draft spatial development strategy must be subject to an examination.
recent.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

recent.name: Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Act 2023.
The Act provides powers to make regulations about the remuneration and working conditions of seafarers working on certain services.
recent.department: Department for Transport
recent.plain: This law uses powers in the Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Act 2023, which lets ministers make rules on pay and working conditions for seafarers working on certain services.

recent.name: Merchant Shipping (General Lighthouse Authorities) (Increase of Borrowing Limit) Order 2027
summary: Under section 215 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995, general lighthouse authorities may borrow money for certain purposes and subject to obtaining the necessary consents.
Under section 216(1) of the 1995 Act, the aggregate amount that may be outstanding in respect of the principal of any sums borrowed is limited to £100 million.
recent.department: Department for Transport
recent.plain: Lighthouse authorities are allowed to borrow money, with the total outstanding limited to £100 million. This Order is about increasing that borrowing limit.

recent.name: International Controlled Transaction Reporting Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the provision of information in relation to international controlled transactions.
recent.department: HM Revenue and Customs

recent.name: Employment Tribunals (Early Conciliation: Exemptions and Rules of Procedure) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Employment Tribunals (Early Conciliation: Exemptions and Rules of Procedure) Regulations 2014 to add to the information that prospective claimants must provide to ACAS in order to comply with the requirement to contact ACAS before instituting proceedings in section 18A of the Employment Tribunals Act 1996.
These Regulations also clarify the 2014 Regulations and make further provision regarding the early conciliation procedure.
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
recent.plain: This law changes the rules on employment tribunals. People who want to bring a claim must first contact ACAS, and this law adds to the information they have to give ACAS when they do. It also clarifies the 2014 rules and adds detail on early conciliation.

recent.name: Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2026
recent.kind: Part of the post-Brexit tidy-up of the law
summary: These Regulations extend by 12 months the transitional arrangements under Parts 2 and 3 of the Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 which enable specified categories of Gibraltar-based firms to provide financial services in the United Kingdom and facilitate the access by similar types of UK-based firms to Gibraltar’s financial services market.
recent.department: HM Treasury
recent.plain: This law extends by 12 months a temporary arrangement that lets certain Gibraltar-based firms provide financial services in the UK. It also helps similar UK firms to reach Gibraltar's financial services market.

recent.name: Export Control (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Export Control Order 2008 and assimilated Council Regulation (EC) No 428/2009 of 5 May 2009 setting up a Community regime for the control of exports, transfer, brokering and transit of dual-use items (Recast).
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
recent.plain: This law changes the Export Control Order 2008 and an EU rule of 5 May 2009 that controls the export, transfer, brokering and transit of dual-use items, meaning goods that can have both civilian and military uses.

recent.name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 (Alternative Dispute Resolution) (Conferral of Functions) (Information) and (Fees) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: The Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 (Alternative Dispute Resolution) (Conferral of Functions) Regulations 2026 conferred eight functions regarding the accreditation and oversight of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) providers on the Chartered Trading Standards Institute.
recent.department: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
recent.plain: An earlier set of regulations gave eight jobs to the Chartered Trading Standards Institute: approving and overseeing the providers that settle consumer disputes without going to court. This law amends the rules on information and fees connected to that role.

recent.name: Data-gathering (Ongoing Data: Interest and Payment Card Transactions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision requiring persons of specified description to provide specified data to His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs on an ongoing basis.
recent.department: HM Treasury
recent.plain: This law requires certain people and organisations to give specified data to HM Revenue and Customs on an ongoing basis.

recent.name: Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 7) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 to refer to a new version of that document.

The new version of that document introduces authorised use measures to reduce the rate of import duty on nine commodity codes relating to steel goods used in the manufacture of bright bar, a precision-finished steel bar product, and wire.
recent.department: HM Treasury
recent.plain: This law updates a customs rule to point to a new version of a document that lowers import duty on nine types of steel goods. They are used to make bright bar, a precision-finished steel bar, and wire.

recent.name: Control of Asbestos (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 to introduce a requirement that the assessment of the cleanliness of the premises, where work relating to asbestos has been carried out, is undertaken by a person who is appointed independently of the person who carried out the work relating to asbestos on those premises.
recent.department: Department for Work and Pensions
recent.plain: This law changes the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012. After asbestos work is finished, the check that the premises are clean must now be done by someone appointed independently of the person who did the work.

recent.name: Contracts for Difference (Electricity Supplier Obligations) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations relate to the levy arrangements that support the Contracts for Difference scheme established under Chapter 2 of Part 2 of the Energy Act 2013.
Government funds can be paid into the scheme to reduce the amount of the levy.
These Regulations amend the Contracts for Difference (Electricity Supplier Obligations) Regulations 2014 so as to broaden the circumstances in which that can happen.
recent.department: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
recent.plain: This law changes the levy that supports the Contracts for Difference scheme. Government money can already be paid in to reduce the levy, and this law widens the circumstances in which that can happen.

recent.name: Charities (Russell-Cotes Art Gallery and Museum) Order 2026
summary: This Order gives effect to the scheme settled by the Charity Commission for England and Wales in accordance with section 73(1)(a) of the Charities Act 2011 for the administration of the charity known as “Russell-Cotes Art Gallery and Museum”.

Prior to the Order coming into force, the Charity was governed by section 57 of the Bournemouth Borough Council Act 1985 and “the Governing Documents” as defined in paragraph 1 of the Schedule to the Order.
recent.department: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport
recent.plain: This Order puts into law a scheme from the Charity Commission for England and Wales for running the Russell-Cotes Art Gallery and Museum charity. Before it, the charity was governed by a section of the Bournemouth Borough Council Act 1985 and its governing documents.

recent.name: Bus Franchising Assessment (Approved Persons) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify types of persons as an approved person for the purposes of section 123D of and paragraph 4(7) of Schedule 9A to the Transport Act 2000.
recent.department: Department for Transport
recent.plain: This law says which types of people count as an approved person under the Transport Act 2000 for the purposes of assessing bus franchising.

recent.name: Adult Social Care Negotiating Body for England Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations create a new, independent body, the Adult Social Care Negotiating Body England under the Employment Rights Act 2025 and set out the operational framework for that body.
recent.department: Department of Health and Social Care
recent.plain: This law creates a new independent body, the Adult Social Care Negotiating Body for England, under the Employment Rights Act 2025. It also sets out how the body will operate.

recent.name: Transport Infrastructure (Fees) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision for prescribed public authorities to charge fees for services provided in connection with certain transport infrastructure projects.
They are made under powers inserted into the Highways Act 1980 and the Transport and Works Act 1992 by the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025.
recent.department: Department for Transport
recent.plain: This law lets certain public authorities charge fees for services they provide on some transport infrastructure projects. It uses powers added to the Highways Act 1980 and the Transport and Works Act 1992 by the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025.

recent.name: Transport and Works (Applications, Objections, Listed Buildings, Inquiries and Decisions Procedure) (England and Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend, subject to the transitional provisions in regulation 1, the Transport and Works (Inquiries Procedure) Rules 2004, the Transport and Works (Applications and Objections Procedure) (England and Wales) Rules 2006 and the Transport and Works Applications (Listed Buildings, Conservation Areas and Ancient Monuments Procedure) Regulations 1992.
recent.department: Department for Transport
recent.plain: This law changes three sets of rules on how applications, objections and inquiries are handled under the Transport and Works system. Some transitional arrangements apply.

recent.name: Sea Fisheries (Amendment and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to assimilated law in the field of sea fisheries.
They also make a transitional provision.
recent.department: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
recent.plain: This law changes the rules on sea fishing that came from the EU and were carried over into UK law. It also includes a temporary arrangement for the changeover.

recent.name: North Somerset (Electoral Changes) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for the district of North Somerset following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.
This Order does not change the boundary of the district itself.
recent.department: Local Government Boundary Commission for England
recent.plain: This Order changes the electoral arrangements for North Somerset, following recommendations from the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. It does not change the boundary of the district itself.
